Case note: Complaint No. 1007/2020
Client: Joseph Bhosale (farmer, Hubballi)
Opposing party: M/s Srivastava Industries
Court: Hubballi Labour Court
Filed on: 2 March 2020
Claim amount: INR 44,60,000/-
Issue: wrongful termination. The employer offered to settle.
Advice given: Negotiate a settlement of gratuity and notice pay.
Outcome: The employer paid gratuity and notice pay under a settlement.
Recommended next step: Sign the settlement and withdraw the complaint.
